title: blocks registry
description: Index of the copy-in source blocks in this repository, read by cli/blocks.mjs.

name.description: Unique block id, kebab-case; matches the block's directory name.

path.description: Directory of the block, relative to the repo root.

description.description: One-line summary of what the block does.

peerDependencies.description: Third-party packages the copied core imports; the consumer installs these. Empty for a zero-dependency block.

license.description: SPDX license id for the block's source. Defaults to the repository license (MIT) when omitted.
